claims: The Artemis II reentry and splashdown occur in the Pacific Ocean west of San Diego.
The Artemis II reentry and splashdown occur on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II reentry and splashdown occur at 8:07 p.m. ET.
The Artemis II reentry and splashdown occur at 5:07 p.m. PT.
